claims.text: CROSS trial, b4 surgery: weekly paclitaxel 50 mg/m2 + carboplatin AUC of 2 + concurrent radiation (vs surgery alone).
claims.quote: The Dutch CROSS phase 3 trial confirmed the superiority of a neoadjuvant chemoradiation therapy approach compared with surgery alone for patients with localized esophageal cancer. The study included 368 patients (23% SCC, 75% adenocarcinoma, 2% other; T2-3, N0-1, M0; majority distal esophageal, 11% EGJ) who were randomly assigned to receive preoperative chemoradiation therapy with weekly paclitaxel 50 mg/m2 plus carboplatin AUC of 2 plus concurrent radiation therapy (41.4 Gy over 5 weeks) or surgery alone.
